body:
Note that adds `workflow_dispatch` to `runner.yml` and `static_checks.yml`, which aren't technically the platform CI. That's not a blocker though; on the contrary, it's a very convenient addition!

One thing to keep in mind with this setup is that the concurrency is only defined at the `runner.yml` level, so a `workflow_dispatch` will NOT cancel an existing workflow. That's probably for the best though, as this allows running multiple specific platform dispatches in tandem. Something more complex than that might need a more involved system, which I can look into after this is integrated, but this'll be good to merge as-is
